rows.grounds: Gloss 'they' + form tā = nom.pl.f of tad.
Gloss 'gradually' + adverbial form kramaśo = indeclinable kramaśas.
Gloss 'coming-to-expansion' + form vikāsamāyāntyaḥ = nom.pl.f pres.part of ā-√i 'to come', compounded with vikāsa; AMBIGUOUS: exact compound boundary uncertain.
Gloss 'mutually-mixed-become-triad-of-tvaras' + complex compound anyonya-āsaṃkīrṇa-tvaratraya; AMBIGUOUS: gender/case of -trayam not determinable from form alone.
Gloss 'with-difference-dissolved-but' + galita-bhedikāḥ with -tu enclitic; AMBIGUOUS: -tu force ('but/indeed') context-dependent.
